LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Me.Meta__Description: The Specification Scrapbook: the project specification's notes, listed on the left column's Specification tab as the code in an annotation bubble beside the note it stands for, so the codes can be read while a drawing is tagged - the Project Specification tab cannot be open beside a sheet. A bubble is dragged onto the paper and lands as an ordinary specification bubble (a leader of type 'bubble') already linked to its note. Owned by Na__LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__.js (the library), Na__LayoutEditor__Panel__ScrapbookSpecification__.js (the tab and its section) and Na__LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__RowEditor__.js (editing a note in its row).
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Me.Meta__Data: There is no library file. The items ARE the project's drawing notes - TrueVision__DrawingNotes__.json beside the project data, the file the Project Specification tab edits and the notes margin lists - read through Na__LayoutEditor__SpecData__, which the editor has already loaded. A note added, renamed, moved or deleted there is added, renamed, renumbered or removed here at once: this is a dynamic scrapbook, and nothing about a note is stored in it.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Me.Meta__Drop: A drop goes through the item clipboard's InsertSet, the one door every scrapbook drop uses: one undo step, the bubble selected, on the sheet's text layer. The bubble lands CENTRED under the pointer, exactly where its ghost was, carrying Leader__SpecNoteId - so it is renumbered with its note, listed in the sheet's notes margin and counted in the specification's usage like a bubble linked by hand. It takes the Leaders panel's settings for new leaders (size, weight, colours, line, fill, endpoint), so it matches the bubbles the Leader tool places; only the type is forced to a bubble.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Me.Meta__Tail: A leader needs a point to mark as well as a head. The bubble is what is dragged, so the tip is given a short tail and left for the hand: select is already up and the leader is selected, so its square tip grip is dragged onto what the note describes, snapping as it always does. Bubble__PointTowardsDrawing aims that tail at the middle of the drawing the bubble was dropped on or nearest to - a bubble dropped to the right of a drawing points left into it, one dropped above it points down - so the tip usually starts on the right side of the bubble. Off, or on a sheet with no drawing, the tail follows Bubble__DefaultSide and drops down the paper.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Me.Meta__Editing: Right-click a row - Edit spec item - or press F2 on it, and the row becomes its note's title and text, checked by the browser's spell check with the practice's dictionary (55__Feature__SpellCheck; the words are in 50__TrueVision__UserConfig/TrueVision__UserSpellings__.json). The caret starts in the word that was right-clicked. Enter saves, Shift+Enter is a new line, Escape puts the row back; clicking away saves too. A save is the Project Specification tab's own (one undo step there, the browser draft, every notes margin following), written at once to the local TrueVision__DrawingNotes__.json and read back; Save Sheets takes it to the cloud (R2).
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Me.Meta__Locate: A specification bubble's right-click menu on the sheet has Show in Specification: this tab comes up, the section opens, a filter hiding the note is cleared, and the note's row is centred in the column and pulses a halo three times.

LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Li.List__Description: How the notes are listed. One row per note, every row styled alike: its bubble, its title and its text. Groups are headed by their prefix and title and do not fold - the filter narrows a long specification instead.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Li.List__BodyClampNote: The lines of a note's text shown before it is cut short with an ellipsis. The whole note is always in the row's tooltip, and Show full notes lists every note in full.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Li.List__FilterMinNotesNote: The filter box and the Show full notes toggle appear once the specification has at least this many notes. A short specification is read at a glance and the controls would only push it down the column.

LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Bu.Bubble__Description: The tail a dropped bubble is given. See Meta__Tail. Millimetres on the paper.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Bu.Bubble__TailRunNote: How far the tip sits from the near edge of the bubble, along the paper.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Bu.Bubble__TailDropNote: How far the tip sits above or below the bubble's centre line.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__Bu.Bubble__DefaultSideNote: 'right' puts the bubble to the right of its tip (the tail runs left), 'left' the other way. Used when PointTowardsDrawing is off.

LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__Description: Every word the tab and its section show. {tokens} are filled in by the module.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__TabHint: The project specification's codes and notes, as bubbles to drag onto the sheet.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__Hint: Drag a bubble onto the sheet: it lands as a specification bubble linked to that note. Then drag its square endpoint onto what it describes. Double-click a row to place one in the middle of the view. Right-click a row to edit its note here.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__ReadOnly: The project specification's codes and notes. Bubbles can only be placed while sheets are editable.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__Failed: The project specification could not be read, so there are no notes to list yet.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__Offline: The cloud copy could not be read: these are the notes kept in this browser.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__Empty: This project's specification has no notes yet. Write them on the Project Specification tab and they appear here, each as a bubble ready to drag onto a sheet.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__FilterTitle: Type a code (RF02), a prefix (RF), or words from a note of three letters or more. Escape clears it.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__FullNotesTitle: List every note in full, instead of its first few lines.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__GroupGeneral: A general group: its notes are listed in every sheet's notes margin, tagged or not.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__RowDrag: Drag onto the sheet, or double-click to place it in the middle of the view.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__RowEdit: Right-click (or F2) to edit the note here.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditKeys: Enter saves · Shift+Enter new line · Esc cancels
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditReadOnly: Notes can only be edited while the sheets are editable.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditNotLoaded: The project specification has not finished loading.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditSpecReadOnly: The project specification is read-only here.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditGone: That note is no longer in the specification.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditRemoved: {code} left the specification while it was being edited, so the edit was not saved.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditFailed: {code} could not be saved just now; the specification did not take the change.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditSavedLocal: {code} saved to the local specification file. Save Sheets sends it to the cloud.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditSavedBrowser: {code} saved in this browser. Save Sheets sends it to the cloud.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__EditLocalFailed: {code} is saved in this browser, but the local specification file was not written ({error}). Save Sheets writes it and sends it to the cloud.
LayoutEditor__ScrapbookSpecification__La.Labels__LocateMissing: That note is not in the project specification any more.
